entities.summary: Arthur Harry Moore was an American attorney and politician of the Democratic Party who served three nonconsecutive three-year terms as governor of New Jersey. He is the longest-served modern governor of New Jersey and the only one elected to three terms. He also served a partial term as United States Senator from 1935 to 1938, before stepping down to begin his third term as governor.
